description: This file defines structures and functions for reading and parsing scheduler statistics from /proc/schedstat in Linux, including per-CPU and per-process data.

classes.name: Schedstat
classes.description: Contains scheduler statistics from /proc/schedstat, including data for multiple CPUs.

classes.name: SchedstatCPU
classes.description: Represents scheduler statistics for a single CPU, including nanoseconds running, waiting, and run slices.

classes.name: ProcSchedstat
classes.description: Holds scheduler statistics for a specific process from /proc/<pid>/schedstat.

methods.name: FS.Schedstat
methods.description: Reads and parses scheduler statistics from /proc/schedstat, returning a Schedstat object.

methods.name: parseProcSchedstat
methods.description: Parses the contents of a schedstat string into a ProcSchedstat object.
